author: The Infographics Show
description:
Gen Z looks at Millennials and sees a generation that worked harder, hustled longer, and still struggled to afford the life their parents took for granted. That may explain what Gen Z really hates about Millennials, and why the generational feud is getting worse.

This video explores how Millennials and Gen Z ended up fighting over the same shrinking opportunities. Millennials entered adulthood during the Great Recession, embraced hustle culture, side jobs, and corporate loyalty, yet many remain stuck in mid-level positions with limited wealth. Gen Z watched all of that happen and reached a very different conclusion: maybe the system isn’t worth playing.
From impossible housing costs and stagnant wages to disappearing entry-level jobs and declining trust in major institutions, both generations are facing the same broken economic ladder. The difference is how they respond to it.
